epic.title: epic-567-door lane B: ExternalBackend refuses a spineless success
epic.intent_and_why: Make it impossible for a dispatched role that drove no spine at all to return a clean success, and delete the mtime-only verification path on the ExternalBackend dispatch path (#432).

definition_of_done: ExternalBackend accepts --spine for verification only (never binds it).
Verify defaults to REFUSE when no spine evidence and no explicit accepted-risk override is given.
Red-proof against the shipped RC.main entrypoint precedes the green-proof.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Full existing test suite green except explicitly-named, explicitly-justified rewrites.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Red/green proofs against RC.main; fresh-process re-verification of the fix.
good_enough.appetite: One bounded Commander lane, one crew gate.

hard_constraints: No edits to scripts/checklist_engine.py or scripts/mcp_spine_server.py (lane A owns both this wave).
No issue filing (triage candidates only, written under .agent-work/567-b/triage-candidates/).
No doctrine promotion (record observation, do not edit docs/agents/*).
fixed_decisions: Sole ownership this wave: scripts/run_crew.py and tests/test_crew_launcher.py.
Do not merge; open PR and return.

current_wave.objective: Close #432 on the ExternalBackend dispatch path.
exit_criteria: Full suite green except named intentional rewrites.

issues.title: ExternalBackend spine-verification fix
issues.desired_outcome: A spineless-but-fresh external crew dispatch defaults to REFUSE, not clean success.
issues.useful_now: Closes the residual named in #567/#432 for this wave.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: pytest tests/test_crew_launcher.py -q, plus the handoff's named red/green proofs.
issues.implementation_latitude: Where the check sits, its evidence shape, test strategy -- per launch order Inherited Latitude.

wave_forecast.outcome: Possible future wave: make --spine mandatory at dispatch time on every external dispatch, forcing the refuse-path universally.
wave_forecast.why_likely: Would close the remaining gap where a dispatcher truly has no target to name at dispatch or verify time.
entry_conditions: Coordinated handoff/doctrine changes across skills this lane does not own (constellation-implementer, constellation-commander crew-dispatch doctrine).

uncertainty_register.unknown: Whether the verify-time default-refuse redesign (post-cold-critic) is itself sufficient, or whether some real dispatcher will routinely have neither a spine target nor a defensible accepted-risk reason.
uncertainty_register.affects: How often --accept-mtime-only-risk gets invoked in practice going forward.
uncertainty_register.settle_by: Observe real ExternalBackend dispatch/verify calls after this lands.
uncertainty_register.current_evidence: None yet -- this lane's own dispatch of its own implementer crew (via the INSTALLED, unmodified run_crew.py) is the only external dispatch observed so far.
uncertainty_register.next_probe: A later wave greps crew-runs.json entries across real runs for mtime_only_risk_accepted frequency.

parked_possibilities: Mandatory --spine at dispatch time (Candidate B, untaken road -- see PLAN_ALTERNATIVES.md).

completed_outcomes.outcome: ExternalBackend.verify() now default-refuses without spine evidence or an explicit accepted-risk override; AND semantics when both a result and a spine are in play; verify-time --verify-spine plus dispatch-time --spine; loud, recorded --accept-mtime-only-risk escape hatch. Red-proof and green-proof both driven against the shipped RC.main entrypoint and, independently, a fresh non-pytest subprocess.
completed_outcomes.evidence: Full suite 217 passed (implementer, Commander, and reviewer each independently re-ran it); Commander's and reviewer's independent fresh-process CLI demonstrations reproducing #432's default-refuse and the AND-semantics refusal; g1-implement-implementer-result.md; g1-reviewer-result.md (APPROVE, no blockers).

wave_evidence.claim: CrewBackend.verify() on the ExternalBackend path is mtime-only today (result_exists + result_fresh, no spine check) -- the #432 gap.
wave_evidence.expected: A spineless-but-fresh external dispatch verifies clean.
wave_evidence.observed: Confirmed via the existing test_verify_result_absent_then_present_marks_completed, run against RC.main (the shipped CLI entrypoint) at understand: dispatch external, write only the result artifact, --verify-result returns 0/completed with zero spine evidence ever produced.

wave_evidence.claim: After the fix, the identical spineless-but-fresh scenario refuses by default (exit 1); the old behavior is reachable only via an explicit, loud, recorded --accept-mtime-only-risk override.
wave_evidence.expected: REFUSED on exit 1 with no override; completed on exit 0 with --accept-mtime-only-risk, printed to both stdout and stderr.
wave_evidence.observed: Reproduced three times independently: (1) implementer's pasted pytest transcript, (2) Commander's own full-suite re-run (217 passed) plus a fresh non-pytest subprocess demonstration (py scripts/run_crew.py directly, explicit tmp root), (3) reviewer's independent full-suite re-run (217 passed) plus two of the reviewer's own fresh-process demonstrations (default-refuse/override, and AND-semantics with a non-terminal spine).
wave_evidence.source: g1-implement-implementer-result.md; g1-reviewer-result.md; Commander's own fresh-process CLI run, this session

wave_evidence.claim: AND (never rescue/OR) semantics hold: a fresh result artifact never excuses a spine that exists but never reached terminal.
wave_evidence.expected: REFUSED even though the result artifact is fresh.
wave_evidence.observed: test_verify_named_spine_not_terminal_refuses passes; independently reproduced by both the reviewer and (separately) not re-derived by the Commander beyond re-running the suite -- reviewer's fresh-process repro is the independent non-pytest confirmation.

discrepancies.signal: Implementing the fix required narrowing docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-07-crew-backend-design.md Decision 2 ('the result contract is backend-invariant ... never forked') for ExternalBackend only -- the base exists-AND-fresh contract stays shared/unforked, but a new spine-evidence gate is layered on ExternalBackend alone.
discrepancies.affects: A prior ratified design decision's prose, now stale relative to shipped code.
discrepancies.evidence: PLAN_ALTERNATIVES.md 'Revision after cold critic'; rewritten BackendInvariantContractTests; g1-implement-implementer-result.md Map Impact section; g1-reviewer-result.md Map impact verdict (confirmed accurate, doc unedited).
discrepancies.reason: Doc-only prose drift with a documented, evidence-backed reason (#432); routed as triage candidate tc1-crew-backend-design-doc-drift.md, not filed as an issue (no-issue-filing pre-ruling) and not fixed directly (doc edit was outside this gate's Allowed Scope of scripts/run_crew.py + tests/test_crew_launcher.py only).

discrepancies.signal: The verify-time default-refuse mechanism still leaves a caller free to reach for --accept-mtime-only-risk routinely instead of ever supplying --verify-spine, which could over time approximate the old mtime-only behavior again, just named and reasoned.
discrepancies.affects: Whether a future wave should make --spine mandatory at dispatch time (Candidate B, the untaken road in PLAN_ALTERNATIVES.md).
discrepancies.evidence: MISSION_FRAME.md decision pressure; PLAN_ALTERNATIVES.md Candidate B rejection rationale (dispatcher usually does not know the crew's plan/spine path until after it returns; making --spine mandatory at dispatch would require coordinated handoff/doctrine changes in skills this lane does not own).
discrepancies.reason: Genuinely a later-wave question, contingent on observing real mtime_only_risk_accepted frequency after this lands -- not evidence this wave's fix is wrong, and not this lane's file ownership to resolve. Routed as triage candidate tc2-mandatory-spine-at-dispatch.md.
